about: What each part of the Studio IS and DOES, for translators. Keys are element ids (exact) or id prefixes ending in '*'; the nearest match up the page wins. JS modules have their own entries under 'js'. Edit freely: python3 scripts/i18n_tool.py extract puts it into every note.

ids.genForm: the Video screen's form where the user describes a video (prompt, mode, quality, length) and presses Generate
ids.modeGroup: the row of video modes: Text (video from words), Character, Image (animate a picture), Start & end frame, Keyframes, Extend (make a clip longer), Add sound, Lip-sync, Remix
ids.formActionFooter: the buttons under the Video form: Generate starts a video, Stop cancels, Batch queues many, Clear form empties it
ids.batchDetails: Batch: queue several videos at once from a list of prompts
ids.shotSetupDetails: Shot setup: size, shape and length of the video
ids.sizingSection: picture size and shape (landscape, portrait, square) of the video
ids.customizeDetails: advanced settings for the video (steps, guidance, seed)
ids.finishDetails: finishing touches applied after the video is made (upscale, frame smoothing)
ids.keyframeSection: Keyframes mode: the user gives pictures that the video must pass through
ids.extendSection: Extend mode: make an existing clip longer by continuing it
ids.upscaleSection: Upscale: make a finished video sharper and bigger
ids.imageSection: Image mode: animate a still picture the user gives
ids.ingredientsSection: Character mode: put a trained character into the video
ids.charactersSection: the user's trained characters (people or styles taught to the model from photos)
ids.charactersComposeState: settings for using a trained character in a video
ids.toolRail: the left side bar that switches between the Studio's tools (Video, One Shot, Images, Storyboard, Editor, Audio, Train Character, Remote Control, Docs, Settings)
ids.workflowTabs: the left side bar that switches between the Studio's tools
ids.bottomPane: the panel under the form: Now (the video being made right now), Queue (videos waiting), Recent (finished ones), Logs (technical messages)
ids.healthCluster: the status chips in the top bar: memory in use, engine state, models on disk
ids.healthPop: the pop-up from the top bar's status chip: what the Mac and the engine are doing
ids.carouselTitle: the gallery of everything the user has made (videos, pictures, sounds)
ids.mainOutputs*: the gallery of everything the user has made (videos, pictures, sounds)
ids.recent*: the list of recently finished videos
ids.expand*: the full-screen viewer for the user's own videos and pictures
ids.player*: the video player showing one of the user's videos, with its actions (download, reuse, delete)
ids.studioSection: the Images screen: make or edit pictures from a description
ids.imgStudio*: the Images screen: make or edit pictures from a description
ids.ideo*: the text-on-picture layout editor (placing words and objects on a poster) in the Images screen
ids.audioSectionTab: the Audio screen: make songs, sound effects and voice from text
ids.audioDrivePane: Lip-sync: a picture of a face talks or sings to the user's audio
ids.music*: the music maker: describe a song or write lyrics and the app composes it
ids.song*: a song the user made with the music maker
ids.speech*: the voice maker: text read aloud by a synthetic voice
ids.trainSection: Train Character: teach the model a person, face or style from the user's photos so it can appear in videos
ids.train*: Train Character: teach the model a person, face or style from the user's photos
ids.oneshotSectionTab: One Shot: one long continuous video with no cuts, planned in parts
ids.os*: One Shot: one long continuous video with no cuts, planned in parts
ids.mvOneShot*: One Shot music video: one continuous video cut to a song
ids.sbSectionTab: Storyboard: plan a short film shot by shot, then make every shot
ids.sb*: Storyboard: plan a short film shot by shot, then make every shot
ids.sbe*: the Editor: a video-editing timeline that puts clips, sound and titles together into a film
ids.edSectionTab: the Editor: a video-editing timeline that puts clips, sound and titles together into a film
ids.edStage: the Editor's main area: preview monitor and timeline of the film
ids.ed*: the Editor: a video-editing timeline for the user's film
ids.remoteSection: Remote Control: use the Studio from the user's iPhone with the Phosphene Remote app
ids.rm*: Remote Control: use the Studio from the user's iPhone with the Phosphene Remote app
ids.settingsModal: the Settings window: models on disk, rendering options, accounts, privacy, appearance, language
ids.proModal: the window about Phosphene Pro, the optional paid membership that supports the project
ids.benchModal: Phosphene Bench: a speed test of this Mac that the user can share
ids.bench*: Phosphene Bench: a speed test of this Mac
ids.civitaiModal: a browser for downloading LoRAs (add-on styles and characters) from the CivitAI website
ids.h3*: controls for the MiniMax H3 video engine
ids.starAsk: a friendly request to star the project on GitHub
ids.page: the top bar of the Studio

js.queue.js: the Video screen: the form, the render queue, the Now card for the video being made, and the gallery of finished work
js.editor.js: the Editor: a video-editing timeline that puts clips, sound and titles together into a film
js.storyboard.js: Storyboard: plan a short film shot by shot, then make every shot
js.characters.js: trained characters, Lip-sync and Train Character
js.engines.js: the video engines (LTX, MiniMax H3) and their quality and length choices
js.settings.js: the Settings window and the models card
js.preview.js: the live preview while a video forms, model downloads and the CivitAI browser
js.health.js: the top bar's status chips, the update banner and app notices
js.stage.js: the Images screen and its text-on-picture layout editor
js.loras.js: LoRAs (add-on styles and characters) and their picker
js.oneshot.js: One Shot: one long continuous video with no cuts
js.remote.js: Remote Control: use the Studio from the user's iPhone
js.bench.js: Phosphene Bench: a speed test of this Mac
js.boot.js: start-up of the Studio page and the output filters
js.whats_new.js: the What's new window shown after an update
js.licences.js: model licence screens the user accepts before downloading a model
js.capabilities.js: greying out what the chosen model cannot do
js.tips.js: small tips shown in the Studio
